create_reader_instance: create a Reader instance from a file path to parse ffcv binary data files
read_header: read the file header to extract num_samples, page_size, and num_fields from an ffcv file
read_field_descriptors: read field descriptors and handlers to map field names to their binary data handlers
read_metadata: read per-sample metadata from the ffcv file using the computed metadata type and sample count
read_allocation_table: read the allocation table from the ffcv file using the alloc_table_ptr offset in the header
